visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation starts with a character against a dark background with a spotlight; the character has wide eyes and covers their mouth with their hands in distress. It transitions to the character lying in bed looking unwell, followed by multiple depictions of the character suffering from headaches, muscle pains, and a stiff neck while a thermometer displays a high temperature. (2) A male host appears in a medium close-up, pointing upwards with a calm expression against a light background. Animation then shows a student sitting amidst a pile of medical books, looking overwhelmed as various disease names float around, eventually collapsing to the floor in a pleading gesture. (3) The scene shifts to an animation of a person driving a red car on a dark road, looking surprised as multiple other red cars appear around them. A brief shot of a circular character with "維C" written on it appears, followed by a person looking at a small wound on their arm. (4) A character is shown reading a medical book labeled with symbols; they suddenly look shocked and clutch their stomach area while a "burning" visual effect is displayed. The scene quickly transitions back to the host and then the "維C" mascot to deliver a punchline. (5) The host returns to the screen, gesturing with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. A famous meme clip of a man blinking in disbelief is inserted briefly. The video ends with the "維C" mascot waving and the host asking a final question to the audience.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 醫學生症候群: 越學越多病?. [Logo]: 維維維. [Subtitle]: 我覺得我要死了. [Variety]: 咚咚. (2) [Subtitle]: 昨天早上起床. (口誤) 明天早上起床. 頭痛、肌肉酸痛、脖子僵硬, 還有點噁心. 吃了止痛藥也沒用. 今天居然還發燒了!. [Variety]: 嗶嗶. 38.1℃. (3) [Subtitle]: 這……這不就是胃炎的症狀嗎!. 等等等等, 別緊張. 這可能是「醫學生症候群」. 是指學生在學各種可怕的疾病時. [Variety]: 救命. 我有症狀. (4) [Subtitle]: 總覺得自己也得了當下在學的那種病. 比如買了紅色車後, 突然發現路上都是紅色的車. 或看到傷口後, 才開始疼痛. [Logo]: 維C. (5) [Subtitle]: 所以當壓力超大的醫學生, 讀到胃病文章後. 這時, 注意到肚子的灼燒感. 「難道我得了胃癌?!」. 結果只是沒吃早餐而已. 通常隨著經驗增長, 這種情況就緩解啦. (6) [Subtitle]: 讓你體驗一下. 比如我說, 你知道你一分鐘眨眼睛多少次嗎. 是不是突然開始在意的自己眨眼睛了?. 那麼, 你也有類似經歷嗎?.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat pop BGM with a slightly nervous synth lead begins immediately. A male voice speaks with high arousal and a worried, fast-paced tone. Distinct 'thud-thud' heartbeat SFX and an electronic 'beep-beep' thermometer SFX are clearly audible over the rhythmic music track. (2) The vocal tone shifts to a more professional and narrative style, though still energetic and clear. The BGM remains continuous and driving at roughly 130 BPM. A subtle paper-rustling SFX is heard as the host mentions studying diseases, maintaining a brisk information-heavy pace. (3) The speech rate remains fast as the narrator describes the red car scenario with a friendly, teasy tone. The BGM beat strength is prominent with steady percussion. A brief comic 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs between visual examples, keeping the energy high. (4) A sharp vocal inflection occurs when the word 'stomach cancer' is shouted with high intensity and dramatic pitch modulation. This is followed by a quick drop in loudness for the punchline, accompanied by a light, comedic 'pop' sound effect to emphasize the anti-climax. (5) The host's voice returns to a conversational and friendly tone. A brief silence occurs during the blinking meme clip to let the visual joke land, followed by a high-pitched 'sparkle' SFX for the mascot character. The audio concludes with a final question delivered with rising intonation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about 'Medical Student Syndrome'—a psychological phenomenon where learning about diseases leads to self-diagnosis of those symptoms—using a humorous and relatable animated format combined with host narration.
